parts: Jr.CH., CH. Big-Foot de Thalek Midnight Storm
Male white and red born on 15 of June of 2013.
POLAND CHAMPION, MOLDAVIAN CHAMPION, BESARABIAN CHAMPION
Mother DNA-identified at the Real Sociedad Canina de España.
From the cross of our latest import Feel The Angel (Dandy) with our beautiful Spanish, Portuguese and International Champion Ghost In Love (Chanel), this beautiful dog was born.

He is now living with our dear friend Barbara Oleszczuk (Kaybaroshi Han & Har) and her Shih Tzu in Poland. We thank her for her trust in us, our dogs and our breeding methods, and for acquiring Storm to show him in Europe.
We hope and wish that his show career will be successful and that we will soon hear news of him at shows, and above all that he will be very, very happy, as he is with his new mum.
